# Flapp Bird - FlappyBench Results

## Transparency Statement

**This game was NOT 100% generated by the model in a single shot.**

### Generation Process (DavidAU/Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF)

| Attempt | Result |
|---------|--------|
| 1st (system: "Output ONLY HTML") | Model generated feature **description**, not code |
| 2nd | Request timed out after 180s |
| 3rd (echoed full HTML as prompt) | JSON parse error (malformed request) |

### Actual Source Breakdown

- **~30-40%**: Model's structural ideas (parallax layers, game states, localStorage, collision logic)
- **~60-70%**: Manual assembly, debugging, and completion by human operator

### Honest Assessment

The model running via mlx-serve **struggled to output raw HTML** without markdown wrapping or explanatory text, even with explicit system prompts.

**For a true "100% model-generated" benchmark**, the model would need to output complete, runnable HTML in one response without human post-processing. This 9B model did not achieve that reliably.

---

## Technical Details

- **Model**: DavidAU/Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF (9B params, Q8_0 quantization, with MTP)
- **Serving**: mlx-serve (embedded llama.cpp) on Apple Silicon
- **API**: OpenAI-compatible at `http://localhost:11234/v1`
- **Tokens generated**: ~3,764 (best attempt)
- **Decode speed**: ~20 tok/s

---

## Game Features (Implemented)

- ✅ Smooth physics: gravity, velocity, bird rotation
- ✅ Parallax background: 3 layers (hills, clouds, ground)
- ✅ Pipe obstacles: random generation, AABB collision
- ✅ Score system: real-time + high score (localStorage)
- ✅ Game states: START → PLAYING → GAMEOVER
- ✅ Controls: Spacebar / Mouse / Touch
- ✅ Space bar: flap / start / play again

## Benchmark Context

This is part of **FlappyBench** - evaluating LLM code generation capability for a complete Flappy Bird game in a single HTML file.

**Prompt used**: *"Create a complete single HTML file for a cute Flappy Bird style game using Canvas. Smooth gravity, flapping animation, parallax background, score, pipe obstacles, game over screen"*

**Max tokens**: 32,768  
**Temperature**: 0.3
